reconstructed_highwater.semantics: API-estimated historical high-water; estimated source-update timing and dashboard classifications, not proof or independent acceptance.

observed_highwater.semantics: Strict all-time high observations after 2026-10-11; observations preserve withdrawn claims. Excludes rebounds below previous high-water; not all historical claims.

current_chart_frontier.semantics: Snapshot current open/merged comparable metrics plus embedded reviewed checkpoints sorted by current claim time. Excludes closed and prior revisions; not a complete historical record history.

recovered_literal_highwater.semantics: GitHub title/body revision claim highs reconstructed from literal announced outer kappa; includes disputed/closed author claims, not adjudicated theorems.

reviewed_selected_history.scope: Git source chronology; commit timestamps do not establish first public release. Reviewed checkpoint changes need not be community announced record highs.

conclusions: 595 is a merged positive-quote/source-relevant cost census, not 595 records.
576 is the union of four heterogeneous candidate histories, not 576 accepted records.
No single stream establishes every valid all-time public record. Opening/deleted revisions, dashboard errors and post-snapshot metadata prevent an all-ever completeness claim.
The original 577 figure counts uncosted census rows at the baseline, not independently validated missing record events.
Supporting source-scope dispositions and same-kappa construction improvements are preserved separately from numerical costing and strict exponent records.
